channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Tereza Cristina diz que não foi nem sondada para vice de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) stated she was never approached to be the running mate of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) in a potential 2026 presidential ticket. She denied any formal or informal discussions about joining his campaign.

item.title: Flávio aponta “insegurança” no Senado e declara voto contra Messias
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated there is a 'very great insecurity' among government base senators ahead of the AGU Jorge Messias' Supreme Court confirmation hearing. He announced his opposition to the nomination, criticizing the current political climate in the Senate.

item.title: Por que investidores estrangeiros avaliam que Brasil vive 'momento de ouro' na economia
item.description: Brazil is attracting foreign investors due to rising oil prices, a strengthening real, and the IMF’s upward revision of its 2026 GDP growth forecast to 1.9%, driven by its status as a net energy exporter. Analysts from Bank of America and Goldman Sachs highlight Brazil as a top beneficiary of the global crisis involving the U.S., Iran, and Israel, with potential to become the 'next gold' in emerging markets. However, experts caution that the 2026 elections and their potential impact on economic policy remain key sources of uncertainty.

item.title: PF diz que ação por faixa com “ladrão” apurava ofensa à honra de Lula
item.description: The Federal Police approached a resident of Presidente Prudente (SP) for displaying a banner with the word 'thief' on his window, near a location where President Lula was scheduled to attend an event. The PF stated it investigated the case as a possible offense against honor, claiming the phrase referred to the president despite lacking his name. The resident said the act occurred on private property and was a personal opinion, with no party affiliation.

item.title: PGR arquiva ação contra Gilmar Mendes por homofobia em críticas a Zema
item.description: The Attorney General's Office archived an investigation request against Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes for a statement deemed homophobic regarding former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema. Mendes had suggested, in an interview, that imagining Zema as a homosexual puppet would be offensive, later apologizing and admitting the error. The PGR concluded there was insufficient evidence to support the homophobia claim.

item.title: “Você entendeu tudo o que eu falei?”, pergunta Zema a Tarcísio
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo), a pre-candidate for President, mocked Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes during a meeting with São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos), asking if he had understood what he had said, implying he was speaking another language. The remark was made in an ironic tone, reinforcing criticism of the Judiciary.

item.title: Tereza diz que possibilidade de ser vice de Flávio é 'pura especulação' e que quer presidir o Senado
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) stated she has not been invited or approached to be Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate in 2026, calling the speculation 'pure conjecture'. She reiterated her goal of presiding over the Senate in 2027, succeeding Davi Alcolumbre, and said there is no clear frontrunner in the 2026 presidential race, with Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula being the two most frequently mentioned names in polls.

item.title: A negativa de Malafaia a Flávio Bolsonaro na busca por eleitorado religioso
item.description: Pastor Silas Malafaia refused to participate in an ecumenical event with Catholic leaders in support of Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy, fearing it would alienate his conservative evangelical base. He believes most evangelicals already support Flávio and that such a joint effort could backfire among his followers. Despite this, Flávio seeks to engage Catholic leaders to counter Lula's advantage among Catholics, while maintaining separate outreach efforts.

item.title: PSD evita mergulhar em pré-campanha de Tarcísio e prioriza a de Caiado à Presidência
item.description: The PSD has decided not to prioritize the re-election campaign of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, choosing instead to focus efforts on the presidential pre-campaign of Ronaldo Caiado. This shift stems from deteriorating relations between PSD president Gilberto Kassab and Tarcísio, following Kassab’s rejection for the vice-governor slot and his subsequent departure from the state government. Despite formal PSD support for Tarcísio’s re-election, the party views the alliance as currently unviable.

item.title: Master, inquérito das Fake News e Código de Ética: o que pensa Jorge Messias, indicado ao STF
item.description: Jorge Messias, Lula's nominee to the STF, prepares for his Senate hearing with a spiritual fast and is expected to technically support a judicial ethics code without commenting on magistrates' conduct. Regarding the Fake News Inquiry, he views it as an important tool but insists it should be used narrowly and within legal limits, opposing calls by the OAB to end the long-running investigation.

item.title: Crusoé: Após ‘Os intocáveis’, surge ‘O herdeiro’ João Campos
item.description: The series 'Os Intocáveis', which gained attention with the support of STF Minister Gilmar Mendes, has inspired a new animated production titled 'O Herdeiro João Campos'. This reflects a growing trend of using animated narratives to shape political discourse ahead of the 2026 elections, a trend allegedly initiated by former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo).

item.title: Atlas/Bloomberg: Irmãos de Flávio Bolsonaro jogam seu teto eleitoral para baixo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is tied with Lula in Atlas/Bloomberg polls, relying on solid right-wing support but needing to win over undecided centrist voters. His moderate strategy is undermined by the belligerent behavior of his brothers, Carlos and Eduardo Bolsonaro, who attack perceived disloyal allies such as Nikolas Ferreira and Romeu Zema, fostering a climate of intolerance that alienates the crucial center.

item.title: A queda de braço na divulgação da margem de lucro das distribuidoras de combustíveis
item.description: Fuel distributors are resisting a government mandate to publicly disclose their profit margins on diesel and LPG sales as a condition for receiving additional subsidies under the Lula administration, arguing it harms competition in a market already stressed by the Middle East conflict. While government technicians acknowledge the measure lacks legal basis and was imposed by decree, a proposed compromise is to require companies to submit the data to the government while keeping it confidential — an idea still facing internal resistance. A decision on whether major companies will join the subsidy program is expected in the coming days.

item.title: Governo Lula insiste em novo encontro e gesto de apoio de Alcolumbre a Messias para destravar votos
item.description: The Lula government continues to seek a public statement of support from Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil - AP) for the nomination of Jorge Messias to a seat on the Supreme Federal Court. The effort aims to secure necessary political backing for the confirmation. As of now, Alcolumbre has not issued an official position.

item.title: Damares diz que oposição votará contra Messias
item.description: Senator Damares Alves (Republicanos-DF) stated that the opposition is closing ranks against Jorge Messias' STF nomination, acknowledging his intelligence but claiming he would serve only to militarize the Court politically. The Senate's CCJ now has 15 favorable and 7 opposed votes after a government-led reshuffle, surpassing the threshold needed for committee approval. If approved in the CCJ, Messias' name will proceed to a secret floor vote in the Senate, requiring at least 41 of 81 senators for final confirmation to the Supreme Court.

item.title: A condição para Flávio Bolsonaro vencer Lula, segundo Ciro Nogueira
item.description: Senator Ciro Nogueira, national president of the Progressistas party, stated that Flávio Bolsonaro has the potential to defeat Lula in the 2026 presidential election, provided he avoids radicalism and positions himself as a unifying figure. He emphasized that the election will be decided by the centrist electorate (around 13%), concentrated in Minas Gerais, São Paulo, and the South, and ruled out a viable third-way candidacy as long as Lula and Flávio remain the main contenders.

item.title: O encontro surpresa entre Alcolumbre e Messias antes de sabatina
item.description: The Attorney General of the Union, Jorge Messias, had an unscheduled meeting with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre in Brasília, days before the confirmation hearing of Lula's nominee to the Supreme Federal Court. The meeting took place amid speculation over the STF vacancy appointment.

item.title: STF vai analisar denúncia contra Gustavo Gayer por injúria contra Lula
item.description: The First Chamber of the STF will analyze on Tuesday the PGR's complaint against federal deputy Gustavo Gayer (PL-GO) for insult against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The complaint, filed in February 2023 and kept under secrecy until now, refers to a publication in which Gayer associated Lula with Hamas and Nazism. The rapporteur of the case is Minister Flávio Dino.

item.title: PGR arquiva pedido de Zema para investigar Gilmar por homofobia
item.description: The Prosecutor General's Office dismissed the request by former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema to investigate Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes for homophobia, ruling that his remarks in an interview did not constitute a violation of LGBTQIA+ collective rights. Mendes later retracted his statement, admitting he erred in referencing homosexuality when discussing an alleged injurious accusation against Zema.

item.title: Governo suspende 3,4 milhões de multas em pedágio "free flow"
item.description: The federal government suspended 3.4 million fines issued under the electronic 'free flow' toll system, giving drivers 200 days (until November 16) to pay outstanding tolls without penalty. After that date, fines will resume. The measure aims to fix data integration issues between concessionaires and the national CNH app, improving transparency and preventing penalties due to lack of information.

item.title: “Não dá para governar” diz Aldo Rebelo ao criticar o STF
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Aldo Rebelo (DC) criticized the Supreme Federal Court, stating 'with this STF it is impossible to govern' and accusing the Court of acting unconstitutionally by blocking executive ministerial appointments. He cited conflicts between Congress and the STF, referencing rulings on the time frame and budget management as examples of 'institutional anarchy,' mentioning cases from the governments of Dilma Rousseff, Michel Temer, and Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Ministro Marco Aurélio Bellizze assume como juiz substituto do TSE
item.description: Minister Marco Aurélio Bellizze of the Superior Tribunal of Justice (STJ) will assume the role of substitute minister at the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) in a ceremony scheduled for this Tuesday by TSE President Minister Cármen Lúcia. Bellizze, a member of the STJ since 2011 and a professor at FGV, previously served as a judge in Rio de Janeiro and became a appellate judge at age 40, currently serving in the STJ’s 2nd Panel and 1st Section, which specialize in Public Law.

item.title: Lula vê placar apertado para Messias no Senado, mas confia em aprovação, dizem aliados
item.description: Lula believes Jorge Messias's Supreme Court nomination will face a tight Senate vote but remains confident in approval, hinging on Messias's performance in Wednesday's hearing. The minister needs 41 votes and currently has 25 in favor and 22 against, with 34 senators undecided or unwilling to declare, requiring at least 16 of them to secure confirmation. Government allies view the situation as 'resolved' but narrow, requiring close monitoring by the Planalto Palace until the vote.

item.title: Presença de Messias na casa de Zanin pegou Alcolumbre de surpresa; veja bastidores
item.description: Davi Alcolumbre was surprised by the presence of Jorge Messias, Lula’s nominee for the STF, at an informal gathering at Justice Cristiano Zanin’s residence, alongside Alexandre de Moraes. Despite Messias’ direct request for support, Alcolumbre avoided giving a clear endorsement, only promising a smooth institutional process in the Senate without committing to vote in favor. The episode left Alcolumbre uncomfortable, viewing it as an attempt to create a false impression of his support, and he believes Messias may still be approved even without his vote.

item.title: Quem é o grupo conservador que reservou a Avenida Paulista para o 1º de Maio
item.description: The conservative group that reserved Avenida Paulista for May 1st consists of the movements Patriotas do QG, Voz da Nação e Marcha da Liberdade, coordinated by the civil organization Projeto União Brasil, founded in 2019 by Malta Jones (Mário Sérgio Malta). Although individually lacking national influence, the groups share a conservative, Christian, and patriotic ideology, with ties to Bolsonarism, pro-gun advocates, and supporters of former President Jair Bolsonaro. The event, scheduled from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m., will feature two sound trucks in front of MASP and Fiesp, and according to the organizer, will avoid attacks on officials or political promotion, focusing instead on praise and speeches defending conservative Christian values.

item.title: Juíza condena ex-comentarista da ‘Jovem Pan’ por dizer que jornalista entrou na ‘CNN’ via cota racial
item.description: Judge Anne Karinne Tomelin of the TJ-DFT ordered former Jovem Pan commentator Paula Schmitt to pay R$ 8,000 in moral damages to journalist Basília Rodrigues for remarks made in November 2023 implying Rodrigues was hired at CNN Brasil via racial quota. The judge ruled the statements were offensive and exceeded the bounds of free speech, despite Schmitt's claim that she was only criticizing the quota system. The decision is subject to appeal.

item.title: Em ano eleitoral, governo Lula anuncia suspensão de 3,4 milhões de multas em rodovias no sistema free flow
item.description: The Lula government announced the suspension of 3.4 million traffic fines in the free flow toll system until November 16, allowing drivers to pay outstanding tolls without fines and recover license points. The measure aims to correct penalties issued due to lack of user information about the new electronic toll system. Concessionaires have 100 days to adapt their systems following the publication of the resolution.

item.title: Zema afirma que equilíbrio de poderes depende de Supremo 'sem rabo preso'
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) criticized the independence of the Supreme Federal Court, calling for a 'Supreme Court without a leash' and accusing justices of avoiding investigations. He renewed his exchange with Minister Gilmar Mendes after the Attorney General's Office dismissed Zema's homophobia complaint against Mendes, which stemmed from Mendes' remarks about a homosexual puppet of Zema. Zema reiterated his critiques target the judiciary's structure, not individuals, calling it lacking credibility and in need of deep reform.

item.title: PGR rejeita investigar Gilmar por suposta homofobia em declaração sobre Zema
item.description: The Attorney General's Office (PGR) decided not to investigate Minister Gilmar Mendes for alleged homophobia after a comment in an interview where he compared offensive depictions of Zema as homosexual to corruption accusations. The PGR concluded there was no injury to LGBTQIA+ rights, emphasizing the minister's public retraction following backlash. The incident occurred amid Zema's public criticism of the STF, and the PGR treated the statement as a rhetorical device acknowledged as inappropriate by Mendes himself.

item.title: Cinco meses após indicação ao STF, Messias se reúne com Alcolumbre por apoio no Senado
item.description: Union Attorney General Jorge Messias, nominated by Lula for the STF, met with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre after five months of waiting. The meeting, also attended by STF ministers Cristiano Zanin and Alexandre de Moraes and Senator Rodrigo Pacheco, was informal and lacked explicit political commitments, though Alcolumbre pledged to ensure a smooth process for the CCJ hearing. Despite the meeting, Alcolumbre avoided public endorsement or promising to influence votes, maintaining caution over Lula’s choice of a trusted ally instead of his preferred candidate, Pacheco.

item.title: Mantega, que levou Vorcaro a Lula, participa de homenagem a Dilma com presidente no Alvorada
item.description: Former Finance Minister Guido Mantega, who facilitated a meeting between former Banco Master owner Daniel Vorcaro and President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, attended a tribute to former President Dilma Rousseff at the Alvorada Palace. The ceremony, hosted by Lula on Monday (27), marked the 10th anniversary of Dilma's impeachment.

item.title: AtlasIntel: Flávio para de crescer e empate com Lula se consolida
item.description: The AtlasIntel poll shows the race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro has reached a point of stability, with Flávio stopping his growth and tying with the president. Over the five rounds released since December, Lula lost 5 percentage points, while Flávio maintained his support level.

item.title: Lula sanciona reajuste das forças de segurança do DF
item.description: President Lula signed into law a salary adjustment for the Federal District’s security forces, with an estimated budget impact of R$ 3 billion in 2026 and 2027. Military police and firefighters received a 50% increase, while civil police saw raises between 24.3% and 27.27%. Lula vetoed 11 provisions of the bill, including changes to the Civil Police structure, automatic public competitions, and benefits for former federal territories, which will now be reviewed by Congress.

item.title: Dino é até hoje o ministro com maior rejeição em sabatina para o STF; veja placar das indicações
item.description: Minister Flávio Dino faced the highest rejection in a STF sabatina in the last two decades, receiving 10 against and 17 in favor votes in the Senate's CCJ. His nomination by President Lula to replace Rosa Weber sparked strong opposition, highlighting political divisions in Congress.

item.title: A popularidade de Lula a 5 meses da eleição, segundo nova pesquisa Atlas
item.description: Lula has 46.8% approval and 52.5% disapproval according to an AtlasIntel poll from April 2026, with a 1-point margin of error. This shows a slight improvement from March, when his numbers were 46% approval and 54% disapproval. 51.3% of voters rate his government as bad or terrible.

item.title: Crusoé: Renan Santos quer atenção
item.description: Renan Santos, a presidential pre-candidate from the Missão party, expressed dissatisfaction with media coverage of the AtlasIntel poll, which highlighted Romeu Zema's performance in a hypothetical second-round runoff against Lula. Santos complained that the press ignored his name and was seeking more attention in the 2026 election campaign.

item.title: Entre Lula e Ciro, Aécio tenta sobreviver no jogo
item.description: Aécio Neves, national president of the PSDB, seeks to ensure his party's survival in the 2026 elections by positioning himself between Lula and Ciro while weighing a Senate run. He praises Rodrigo Pacheco (PSB), Lula's preferred candidate for Minas Gerais government, and criticizes Romeu Zema (Novo) and Mateus Simões (PSD), signaling a strategy of rapprochement with the Lulist camp despite his history as a PT opponent.

item.title: Mendonça mantém decisão para nova avaliação de advogado em cota racial
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça upheld a decision requiring a new heteroidentification assessment for Hugo Assis Passos, a self-declared pardo lawyer competing for a racial quota seat on the Maranhão Court of Justice. The ruling criticized the OAB-MA commission for merely marking an 'x' without explaining phenotypic criteria, violating administrative motivation and defense rights. Mendonça emphasized that the TRF-1 correctly ruled the administration must redo its act validly, and that local commissions are better suited to assess regional racial nuances, especially in Maranhão, where 66.4% of the population is pardo.

item.title: Lula mantém liderança no 1º turno, mas segue numericamente atrás de Flávio no 2º, mostra pesquisa AtlasIntel
item.description: Lula maintains his lead in the first round of the 2026 presidential election, according to an AtlasIntel poll released on April 28. However, in a potential second-round scenario, he trails numerically behind Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, though within the margin of error, indicating a technical tie.

item.title: Morador é abordado por faixa com “ladrão” perto de evento de Lula
item.description: A resident of Presidente Prudente (SP) was approached by men identified as Federal Police agents after displaying a banner reading 'thief' on his apartment window near an event with President Lula. The video of the encounter was shared by pre-candidates Flávio Bolsonaro and Nikolas Ferreira, who criticized the action as censorship. There is no official confirmation from the PF regarding the agents' identity or the legality of the approach.

item.title: Pesquisa expõe cansaço dos eleitores de Minas com a polarização e traz péssima notícia a Zema
item.description: The Genial Quaest poll shows that although 52% approve of Romeu Zema's management in Minas Gerais, only 13% want his continuation, with 44% demanding a complete change in administration. Voters exhibit fatigue with polarization: 37% prefer an independent governor, while Cleitinho Azevedo leads the presidential race with 30% voting intentions, ahead of Alexandre Kalil (14%) and Rodrigo Pacheco (8%).

item.title: Quaest: 52% aprovam e 41% desaprovam governo Romeu Zema em MG
item.description: The Quaest poll shows 52% of Minas Gerais voters approve of former governor Romeu Zema's (Novo) government, while 41% disapprove, with 6% undecided. Zema resigned in March to run for president in 2026, and the state is currently led by Vice Governor Mateus Simões (PSD). The survey also found that 44% of voters believe the next governor should completely change the current government, compared to only 13% who support continuity.

item.title: Partido Liberal de Bolsonaro quer tabelar preços dos combustíveis
item.description: The Liberal Party, once a defender of economic orthodoxy, now supports a proposal by Senator Marcos Rogério (PL-RO) to cap fuel prices during crises, breaking with international parity and advocating state intervention in the market. Despite historical inefficacy, this shift reflects the party’s ideological transformation under Jair Bolsonaro’s influence, who has designated his son Flávio Bolsonaro as the PL’s presidential candidate for 2026.

item.title: Genial/Quaest: governo de Minas tem piora na avaliação e queda na aprovação, enquanto Zema tenta projeção nacional
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll shows that approval of Romeu Zema's government in Minas Gerais dropped from 62% in February 2025 to 52% in April 2026, with disapproval rising from 30% to 41%. Negative evaluation of the administration nearly doubled, from 14% to 26%, and 49% of voters believe Zema does not deserve to elect a successor, indicating strong rejection of his political group's continuity. Despite declining approval, Zema is gaining national visibility through clashes with the STF, particularly Justice Gilmar Mendes, boosting his profile as a potential presidential candidate.

item.title: Governo Zema tem aprovação de 52% dos mineiros, diz Quaest
item.description: A Quaest poll released on April 28, 2026, shows 52% of Minas Gerais voters approve of former governor Romeu Zema's (Novo) administration, while 41% disapprove. Government evaluation reveals 32% positive, 36% regular, and 26% negative ratings. Zema, re-elected in 2022, is barred from running for a third term in 2026 under Brazilian re-election laws.

item.title: Alcolumbre decide não receber Messias e influência dele deve definir destino de indicação ao STF
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) has declined to meet with STF nominee Jorge Messias to maintain neutrality, despite having previously warned the Lula government about Senate resistance. His influence over 12 to 15 undecided senators aligned with the 'centrão' bloc may determine the outcome, as favorable vote projections have dropped from 46 to 44. The government is attempting to sway votes through parliamentary amendment negotiations, but senators remain resistant, leaving the nomination in a tight spot with 25 firm supporters, 35 opponents, and 21 undecided.

item.title: PGR blinda Gilmar e arquiva pedido de investigação por homofobia
item.description: The Prosecutor General's Office archived a request to investigate Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes for alleged homophobia following an interview with Metrópoles, in which he criticized presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema of the Novo party. The request accused Mendes of making an 'injurious accusation' against Zema, but the PGR found insufficient grounds to initiate a civil public action.

item.title: Crusoé: Zema encosta em Lula no segundo turno, indica AtlasIntel
item.description: An AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll shows Romeu Zema (Novo) narrowing the gap with Lula (PT) in a hypothetical runoff, rising from 43.7% to 46.5% in voting intentions, while Lula increased slightly from 46.6% to 47.4%. The result indicates a technical tie within the margin of error, with Zema gaining ground against the president.

item.title: Desenrola 2.0: 8 perguntas e respostas sobre o programa que dará desconto em dívidas
item.description: The Lula government is preparing to launch Desenrola 2.0, a debt renegotiation program offering discounts of 20% to 90% on bank debts and interest rates below 2% per month, initially targeting individuals earning up to five minimum wages. Announced ahead of May 1st, the initiative aims to ease household financial strain and boost purchasing power in an election year, responding to rising indebtedness and delinquency, as well as Flávio Bolsonaro's growing poll numbers.

item.title: AtlasIntel: Lula lidera no 1º turno e empata tecnicamente com Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º
item.description: Lula leads in all first-round scenarios tested by AtlasIntel/Bloomberg, while Flávio Bolsonaro is technically tied with him in a potential runoff, at 47.8% to 47.5% — a mere 0.3 percentage point difference. Romeu Zema follows as the second most competitive opponent with a 0.9-point deficit, while Ronaldo Caiado and Renan Santos trail significantly. The survey interviewed 5,008 voters across Brazil’s five regions from April 22–27, with a 95% confidence level and a 1-point margin of error.
